name: @core/directions
summary: Art directions: one composition, many looks (theme, pace, transitions, overlays, sounds).
guide:
Art directions change the whole look of a composition without touching its scenes. Put "direction": "dir:cinematic" (or {"p": "dir:tech", "accent": "#0ff"}) at the top of a composition.
DIRECTIONS: cinematic, corporate, playful, tech, editorial, brutal, documentary, luxury, minimal — all take {accent}.
A direction sets theme, tokens, fonts, pace (×scene durations), animScale (×animation durations), default transitions between scenes that have none, defaults for scene params (backdrop…), overlays on every scene and sounds per event. The composition's own theme/tokens/transitions win.
OVERLAY ELEMENTS (usable anywhere): dir:grain{amount}, dir:vignette{amount}, dir:letterbox{size,color}, dir:scanlines{amount}, dir:frame{inset,color,opacity}.
Compare looks with mf_variants {"directions": ["dir:cinematic", "dir:tech", "dir:corporate"]}.
